gemini.description: Free within Google's limits. Choose the model above, for chat and for analysis.

confirmRemove.title: Remove the Gemini key?
confirmRemove.description: Chat and AI feedback will turn off until you add another key.

help.title: How to get the key
help.step1: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account.
help.step2: Select “Create API key” and choose or create a project.
help.step3: Copy the key and paste it here. Treat it like a password.

openrouter.descriptionShort: Alternative to Gemini: hundreds of models (Claude, GPT, DeepSeek…) with one key.
openrouter.descriptionFull: Alternative to Gemini: hundreds of models (Claude, GPT, DeepSeek…) with one key, pay as you go. Choose the model above, for chat and for analysis.
openrouter.migrationNeeded: To turn it on, the database needs updating with migration 0023.
openrouter.justSaved: Key saved. Now, above, choose OpenRouter and a model for chat or analysis.

confirmRemove.title: Remove the OpenRouter key?
confirmRemove.description: Chat and analysis will use Gemini.

help.title: How to get the key
help.step1: Create an OpenRouter account and add some credit (“free” models don't use it).
help.step2: Under “Keys”, create a key and paste it here. Treat it like a password.
help.step3: Above, under “Models”, choose OpenRouter and tap the model to see the list with prices.

apiKey.description: To upload runs from Shortcuts or other services without opening the app.
apiKey.label: Personal key
apiKey.empty: No key set up. Generate one to get started.

confirmRegenerate.title: Regenerate the personal key?
confirmRegenerate.description: Shortcuts set up with the current key will stop working until you update them.

help.title: How to use it
help.step1: Generate the key, show it and copy it.
help.step2: In the external service, use the header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY.
help.step3: Choose the endpoint that fits what you're sending.
help.regenerateNote: If you regenerate the key, update every Shortcut that used the previous one.
